caption: The drawing features a rectangular frame with a peaked top, colored in shades of purple, brown, and red. Inside the frame, the composition is densely filled with stylized, symmetrical figures and floral elements. The central figure is a woman in a red dress with green veil, hands together in prayer, standing within a pointed oval shape bordered in red and green, surrounded by radiating black and yellow lines. Below her is a small angelic figure with wings, wearing a red shirt and tan pants, holding up the central oval. Flanking the central figure are four smaller, similarly dressed women in red garments and green veils, each enclosed in their own red and green ovals with yellow highlights, two on each side. In the upper section, there are three busts of figures; the center one wears a pointed red hat and turquoise blue robe, while the figures on either side wear patterned garments in shades of brown, red, and white, and have distinct facial features. The background is pale yellow, filled with red, green, and black floral and leaf-like shapes. Across the peaked top are two brown bird-like forms on a mauve background. The drawing uses bold black outlines and a palette of red, green, yellow, brown, and purple, with figures and floral decorations evenly distributed across the composition.
title: Plate 32: Our Lady of Guadalupe": From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
